raw:
@q query
  select ?m
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "forță majoră"
    role object ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?m
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "amortizare"
    role object ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end
